name: Altering The Body
overview: Scripture reveals that God values the sanctity of the human body as His creation, as seen in Leviticus 19:28 where He commands against making cuttings or marks on the flesh. This respect for the body is rooted in the truth that God formed and ordained each person before birth (Jeremiah 1:5), affirming His sovereign design. The subtlety of deception introduced in Genesis 3:1 contrasts with God's authority, reminding believers to trust His word rather than altering His creation. Ultimately, through faith in Christ, believers receive the privilege to become children of God (John 1:12), embracing their identity as His workmanship rather than reshaping their bodies to conform to worldly standards.
